# Roleplay Rule 3 - Validhunting
Don't go out of your way as a crew member to harm antagonists without reason.
If an antagonist makes themself your problem, feel free to attack them.
## Examples
### [bold] Permitted [/bold]
- Hunting an antagnoist who is a direct threat to you, such as a traitor who tried and failed to kill you. - Hunting an antagnoist who is a threat to the station, such as nukies, or a known and dangerous heretic. - Hunting a traitor that is killing everyone. - Hunting an antagnoist that security has failed to deal with. - Hunting an antagnoist when most of security is dead.
### [bold] Not Permitted [/bold]
- Going out of your way to hunt antagnoists that pose no threat to you. - Searching for antagonists as non-sec for no reason.
